description: Ecuador's national risk and emergency management service (SNGR) publishes information on hazardous events in the country as a free online service. The service page read on 2026-09-28 says any natural person aged 18 to 80, public or private legal entity or non-governmental organisation can download, free of charge, the information on hazardous events generated by the service, by going to the page of current situation reports on adverse events and choosing either situation reports or hazard monitoring maps; the page cites the legal basis in the constitution and the public security law, and recent posts cover preparations for El Niño 2026-2027 and the 2026 forest fire season. Coverage is national. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: situation reports are PDF bulletins per event, so impacts (affected people, houses, roads, bridges) must be transcribed, and the archive depth was not checked. It supports event records for emergency response analysis and hazard exposure of Ecuadorian roads, housing and services. Related records: data-igepn-ecuador-seismic-volcanic-data and data-inamhi-ecuador-hydromet-yearbooks-maps complement it with hazard data.
